event: UK Biobank data first made available to researchers under the historical access model
source_date: Updated 21 January 2026; release chronology dates March 2012
projects_affected: All projects seeking UKB data after launch
expected_timing_implication: Establishes long pre-period with download/data-release system before RAP-default transition
relevance_to_public_start_date: Defines the historical regime against which recorded project starts are observed
directly_documented_fact: Past-release chronology says baseline data were first made available in March 2012 and lists later releases by month.
interpretation_or_inference: The public Start date should be interpreted within a long-running approved-project access system, not as a newly created application measure.

event: UKB-RAP launched
source_date: Edited 19 November 2024; source says UKB-RAP launched in 2021
projects_affected: Projects using UKB-RAP before the 2024 default switch
expected_timing_implication: May have affected subsets of RAP-intensive projects before July 2024, especially genomics
relevance_to_public_start_date: Shows RAP existed before the 2024 breakpoint, so July 2024 is a default-access transition, not platform birth
directly_documented_fact: UKB states that it launched UKB-RAP in 2021 and that about one-third of active projects were solely on UKB-RAP at the transition announcement.
interpretation_or_inference: Pre-2024 RAP use may create heterogeneous exposure but does not define the aggregate project-entry breakpoint.

event: OMOP release on RAP
expected_timing_implication: May have pulled some users onto RAP before the formal default switch
relevance_to_public_start_date: Relevant only as evidence that some data assets were already RAP-mediated before July 2024
directly_documented_fact: Past-release list records transformed UKB OMOP data as available on RAP in July 2023.
interpretation_or_inference: RAP-specific data releases may matter for heterogeneity, but not for aggregate project-start timing.

event: Main 500k whole-genome sequencing release via RAP context
expected_timing_implication: Could increase RAP-oriented applications before July 2024
relevance_to_public_start_date: Context for RAP-intensive access before default switch
directly_documented_fact: Past-release list records the final tranche of 500k WGS data in late 2023; the transition announcement states genomic sequence data was already RAP-only.
interpretation_or_inference: This strengthens the view that July 2024 changed the default access regime, not every data pathway simultaneously.

event: Application and registration review process
expected_timing_implication: Review and registration requirements can delay movement from submission to operational access
relevance_to_public_start_date: Start date is downstream of submission because access requires later approval, MTA, payment, and release steps
directly_documented_fact: UKB lists five access stages before access: Application, Registration, Access Committee review, MTA, and Sample/Data Release.
interpretation_or_inference: Recorded starts should not be called new applications without additional evidence.

event: Formal approval, paid charges, and executed MTA required before access
expected_timing_implication: Outstanding payment or MTA can postpone access and therefore recorded start timing
relevance_to_public_start_date: Strongly implies public Start date is not application submission or approval alone
directly_documented_fact: FAQ says access is granted when UKB has formally approved the application, all charges have been paid, and the MTA has been signed, returned, and executed.
interpretation_or_inference: The public Start date is safest to interpret as recorded project start or operational access date after administrative prerequisites.

event: Official FAQ says average time from application submission to data release is 15 weeks
expected_timing_implication: Creates expected lag between application submission and data access/release
relevance_to_public_start_date: Directly argues against treating project starts as contemporaneous applications
directly_documented_fact: UKB states that it takes an average of 15 weeks from application submission to data release.
interpretation_or_inference: Monthly new_projects should be labelled recorded project starts, not new application submissions.

event: MTA and payment required before data access is granted
expected_timing_implication: Administrative completion can shift start timing after approval
relevance_to_public_start_date: Strong support for interpreting Start date as downstream of MTA/payment completion
directly_documented_fact: UKB says data access requires a fully signed and executed MTA for the applicant institute and each named collaborating institute, plus invoice payment.
interpretation_or_inference: Institutional/institute processing may create batching or delay even without a formal application pause.

event: RAP-by-default transition for new projects and additional data for existing projects
source_date: Post edited 19 November 2024; study metadata treats source event as 5 July 2024
process_stage_affected: Access modality, onboarding, data updating, exemptions
projects_affected: All new projects and existing projects seeking additional data, subject to limited exceptions
expected_timing_implication: Affects the access route and prerequisites for operational projects from the transition point
relevance_to_public_start_date: Primary external breakpoint for recorded project starts because operational access moved to RAP by default
directly_documented_fact: UKB announced that all data for new projects and additional data for existing projects would be available solely on UKB-RAP with limited exceptions.
interpretation_or_inference: Use July 2024 as the primary institutionally anchored breakpoint; do not infer narrower month windows from outcomes.

event: UKB data updates held until Q4 2024 during transition
expected_timing_implication: May reduce differential data-version timing during transition; could affect researcher incentives or activation timing
relevance_to_public_start_date: Context for transition phase, but not direct evidence of project-start pause
directly_documented_fact: UKB said data would not be updated until Q4 2024 so existing and newly approved projects had equal access during the transition phase.
interpretation_or_inference: This supports a broader transition context, not a July-September project-start interruption dummy.

event: RAP account creation requires approved AMS account, collaborator listing, and AMS-to-RAP linking
process_stage_affected: RAP account creation and AMS-RAP linking
expected_timing_implication: Adds user/account linking steps after AMS approval
relevance_to_public_start_date: Relevant because RAP access is only possible after project status changes and account linkage
directly_documented_fact: UKB says RAP registration has two steps and that users must have an approved AMS account and be listed on an approved RAP application.
interpretation_or_inference: The public Start date is closer to operational readiness than to research idea submission.

event: Dispensing data to a RAP project usually takes up to 24 hours after training and RAP use
projects_affected: Projects already using UKB-RAP after mandatory training
expected_timing_implication: Data dispensing is a short final step once upstream prerequisites are met
relevance_to_public_start_date: Start date is unlikely to mean first data dispense alone without upstream AMS status completion
directly_documented_fact: UKB says that once training is complete and the researcher is using UKB-RAP, data usually takes up to 24 hours to dispense to the project workspace.
interpretation_or_inference: Recorded starts may occur before or around first data dispense, but public evidence does not pin the exact field definition.

event: Mandatory researcher training courses released and/or made available
source_date: Post 09 October 2024; official comment edited 16 October 2024
projects_affected: Researchers seeking UKB-RAP access, including already approved projects waiting for training
expected_timing_implication: Could delay operational access until training materials and tests are available
relevance_to_public_start_date: Provides support for transition/onboarding context in October 2024, but not an official October restart
directly_documented_fact: Official UKB Community comment said on-demand training courses had been released and were available; user posts show some courses were not yet findable in early/mid October.
interpretation_or_inference: October 2024 may include training availability changes, but the observed start rebound is not documented as an institutional restart.

event: Mandatory UKB-RAP training requirement and existing-user completion deadline
projects_affected: Existing UKB-RAP users; new RAP users seeking access
expected_timing_implication: Training completion can gate access and can pause or prevent project operation until fulfilled
relevance_to_public_start_date: Supports a transition/onboarding window extending beyond July 2024
directly_documented_fact: UKB said researchers must complete three mandatory training courses to access data on UKB-RAP, with existing RAP users required to complete by 31 March 2025.
interpretation_or_inference: The end of March 2025 is a defensible training compliance date, but not a direct project-entry breakpoint.

event: Project not enabled for RAP unless training, MTA, payment, and AMS Underway status are satisfied
process_stage_affected: Training, MTA, payment, AMS Underway status, RAP enablement
expected_timing_implication: Approved-but-not-underway projects are not enabled; prerequisites can delay recorded starts
relevance_to_public_start_date: Strongly implies Start date tracks operational/underway status rather than application approval
directly_documented_fact: UKB says an application marked Approved but not Underway is not enabled for RAP access and lists training, executed MTA, and payment criteria.
interpretation_or_inference: For empirical labeling, use recorded project starts or projects becoming operational; avoid new applications.

event: After existing-user mandatory training deadline
source_date: Deadline stated in post edited 14 November 2024
projects_affected: Existing RAP users and projects needing compliant access
expected_timing_implication: Potential normalization of access after training deadline, but not a new access-policy breakpoint for project starts
relevance_to_public_start_date: Possible secondary context after the transition/onboarding phase
directly_documented_fact: Existing UKB-RAP users had a 31 March 2025 deadline for training completion.
interpretation_or_inference: April 2025 can mark post-deadline context, not a primary break unless the paper motivates a secondary period.

event: First major listed post-transition data release in the available release chronology
expected_timing_implication: May affect demand for access and new project starts after transition
relevance_to_public_start_date: Context, not a project-entry administrative breakpoint
directly_documented_fact: Past-release chronology lists a March 2025 data release with questionnaire, imaging, genetics, healthcare, environmental, and other updates.
interpretation_or_inference: Data-release timing can shape demand but should not define the July 2024 project-entry ITS break.

event: Formalized UKB-RAP-by-default exemption policy and application process
source_date: Updated 03 July 2025; related exemption application article updated 08 October 2025
process_stage_affected: Download exemption review, Access Committee, compliance
projects_affected: Projects requesting temporary non-RAP data access
expected_timing_implication: Exemption review may add review time for nonstandard access requests
relevance_to_public_start_date: Reinforces RAP-default regime after 2024 but is not a 2024 project-entry breakpoint
directly_documented_fact: UKB states exemption requests are reviewed by Access and Scientific Teams with Access Committee decision and lists permitted rationales.
interpretation_or_inference: Useful for institutional background and robustness discussions only.

event: Insurance company direct access policy changed
source_date: Page last updated 23 April 2026; page states policy up to January 2025 and no longer accepting such applications
expected_timing_implication: May affect a narrow applicant subset
relevance_to_public_start_date: Limited relevance to aggregate public Start date
directly_documented_fact: UKB says it no longer approves applications from insurance companies for direct access to de-identified UKB data.
interpretation_or_inference: Too narrow and applicant-type-specific for primary project-entry ITS.

event: Observed low recorded project starts in project-start data
source_date: Generated project data in this repository
projects_affected: Recorded project starts in public metadata
expected_timing_implication: Low observed counts may describe an interruption, but the window is not independently documented as a formal pause
relevance_to_public_start_date: Descriptive anomaly only unless linked to external source
directly_documented_fact: Repository data record July 2024 = 3, August 2024 = 0, September 2024 = 1 starts.
interpretation_or_inference: Do not create a July-September dummy in the primary ITS merely because these observed values are low.

event: Observed rebound in recorded project starts
source_date: Generated project data in this repository
projects_affected: Recorded project starts in public metadata
expected_timing_implication: High observed count may reflect backlog, batching, or demand, but this is not officially documented in the sources reviewed
relevance_to_public_start_date: Descriptive anomaly only
directly_documented_fact: Repository data record October 2024 = 208 starts.
interpretation_or_inference: October 2024 is an observed rebound in recorded project starts, not a documented institutional restart.
